<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>The secrets master key does not match the one this database was set up with: stored secrets cannot be decrypted. Restore the original key (SENTIENT_SECRETS_KEY or the key file …).</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>secret &#x27;NAME&#x27;: …</span></div>

## Why it happens

The database was restored or moved without its key file `secrets.key`, so SENTIENT created a new key. Every secret and every password typed into configuration is encrypted with the old key.

## Fix it

1. Stop SENTIENT.
2. Put the original key file back (in Docker: `/var/lib/sentient/secrets.key`), or set `SENTIENT_SECRETS_KEY` to the original key.
3. Start SENTIENT.

If the original key is lost, the stored values cannot be recovered. Enter each secret and stored password again.

## Check that it worked

The start-up log no longer shows the message, and integrations and rule nodes that use secrets work.
